import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 250005;
    static int n, kk, P;
    static long[] fac = new long[N], inv = new long[N];
    static long[][] dp = new long[26][N];
    static long[][] memo = new long[26][N];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
    }

    static long qpow(long a, long b) {
        long ret = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ret = ret * a % P;
            a = a * a % P;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int lowbit(int x) {
        return x & -x;
    }

    static long dfs(int cur, int msk) {
        if (dp[cur][msk] != -1) return dp[cur][msk];
        if (msk == 0) {
            long res = fac[n];
            for (int i = 1; i <= cur; i++) {
                res = res * (kk - i + 1) % P;
            }
            dp[cur][msk] = res;
            return res;
        }
        long res = 0;
        int tmp = msk - lowbit(msk);
        for (int i = tmp; i > 0; i = (i - 1) & tmp) {
            res = (res + inv[msk - i] * dfs(cur + 1, i)) % P;
        }
        res = (res + inv[msk] * dfs(cur + 1, 0)) % P;
        dp[cur][msk] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        kk = sc.nextInt();
        P = sc.nextInt();
        long ans = qpow(kk, n);
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ans);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P;
        }
        inv[n] = qpow(fac[n], P - 2);
        for (int i = n; i > 0; i--) {
            inv[i - 1] = inv[i] * i % P;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        long temp = dfs(0, n);
        ans = (ans - temp + P) % P;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
